sourceNotes.rawContent:
✨ A little jar, a lot of sparkle! 🫙🤍
Get ready for a fun and exciting unboxing with the Surprise Mystery Jewellery Jar by Morchadi Jewels. Each jar is packed with a curated mix of trendy anti-tarnish and Korean-style jewellery pieces, giving you 8–9 surprise jewellery items to discover.
🎀 What's Inside?
Every ₹599 Mystery Jar contains:
- 💎 8–9 jewellery items
- ✨ A mix of anti-tarnish jewellery & Korean-style pieces
- 🌸 Trendy, cute and wearable designs
- 🎁 Beautiful jar packaging, perfect for gifting
- 🤍 Different combinations in every jar for a true mystery experience
The exact jewellery designs are kept secret, so you won't know what's inside until you open your jar! That makes every unboxing a little more exciting. ✨
💕 Perfect For
- Jewellery lovers who love surprises
- Birthday & friendship gifts
- Self-gifting and treat-yourself moments
- Korean jewellery lovers
- Girls who love trendy, aesthetic accessories
- Anyone looking for a unique affordable gift
✨ Why You'll Love It
✔️ 8–9 jewellery items in every jar
✔️ Anti-tarnish styles included
✔️ Korean-inspired trendy jewellery
✔️ Surprise assortment in every jar
✔️ Beautiful gift-ready presentation
✔️ Perfect for everyday styling & gifting
✔️ Just ₹599
Small jar. Big happiness. Endless sparkle. ✨
Designs, colours and styles may vary from the images shown. Each jar is curated individually, so the exact contents remain a surprise.
Please Note : Cash on delivery is not available for this Product
